summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-base preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods it, then invokes the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js],...)`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `@bun-cjs` bundle with hex-mangled identifiers and a string-array rotation cipher (`WV8StW` rotates a ~1000-entry literal table). A Babel preset has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate runtime or execute an obfuscated bundle at install time, and the payload is deliberately structured so that Node-based inspection cannot read it. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install`, and the advertised package purpose (Babel preset for the @ornikar scope) does not match the shipped install-time contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
